title: Van Foong - Silk Weaving Factory

page_data.en:
Misc. 20/42.
Yangtsepoo 1104
March. 16th, 42. 42

Re-opening of Industrial Concern.

D.S.I. Smith

Sir,

I beg to report that the Van Foong (萬丰) Silk
Weaving Factory located at Houses 59-65, Lane 126 Linching
Road re-opened for manufacturing purposes, on the
16/3/42.

The factory is under Chinese ownership and employs
32 male and 10 female Chinese.

Sl. B
14.3.42
el
17/3

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
W.G. Smith & Kurogane..
D. S. I.

D.O. "D"
Copy to O.i/c SpBr. Direct.

21/3
17/3

DATE 20/3/42

杂项 20/42。
杨树浦 1104
1942年3月16日。42

关于一家工业企业重新开业的事宜。

副巡长史密斯

先生：

谨此报告，位于临清路126弄59-65号的万丰（Van Foong）丝织厂已于1942年3月16日重新开工生产。

该厂为华人所有，雇佣华籍男工32名，女工10名。

Sl. B
